name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: A central sector scheme providing income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to supplement their financial needs for agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs.
benefits: Rs. 6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months, transferred directly to the bank accounts of eligible farmers via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to exclusions
Farmer families holding constitutional posts, serving/retired government officers and employees above certain pay grades are excluded
Income tax payers in the last assessment year are excluded
how_to_apply: Register online at pmkisan.gov.in via the 'Farmers Corner' > 'New Farmer Registration' using Aadhaar number, or apply through the local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Patwari / Revenue Officer / Nodal Officer nominated by the state government.
